span.normalized: Once in commercial production, Phase 1 of Thacker Pass is expected to substantially increase U.S. domestic production of lithium to help the U.S. reduce dependence on foreign countries for supply. With a strategic investment, joint venture partnership and long-term offtake agreement with General Motors, production from Thacker Pass Phase 1 is estimated to support lithium needs for up to 800,000 EV’s annually (assuming lithium carbonate equivalent (“LCE”) intensity of 850 tonnes (“t”) of LCE per GWh.
